text.en: Magallan is a field specialist employed by Rhine Lab, operating under a cooperation agreement with Rhodes Island. She is currently based with us as she prepares to launch a new expedition. Magallan is skilled in the operation of highly modular drones, using them for attack or support as the situation dictates.
text.zh: 麦哲伦，莱茵生命实验室外勤专员，在合作协议的作用下，暂计划以罗德岛为据点，开始新一轮的探索活动。擅长操控高度模块化无人机，因地制宜进行攻击或支援友军。

text.en:
Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory system and there are no other signs of infection. At this time, this operator can be confirmed to be uninfected.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0%
Operator Magallan shows no signs of Oripathy infection.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.14u/L
Regularly operates in unknown environments, must take appropriate protective measures.
text.zh:
造影检测结果显示，该干员体内脏器轮廓清晰，未见异常阴影，循环系统内源石颗粒检测未见异常，无矿石病感染迹象，现阶段可确认为非矿石病感染者。

【体细胞与源石融合率】0%
干员麦哲伦没有被源石感染的迹象。

【血液源石结晶密度】0.14u/L
常在未知地域里活动，一定要做好相关防护措施哦。

text.en:
[Originium Arts Overview] 
'Lutra Workshop and Rhine Lab Development joined forces to create Magallan's custom-made exploration suit. It includes a wide variety of sensor systems, as well as an Egret-type support drone!'

Multi-functional survey sensor systems
High temperature, low temperature, high pressure, all-environment work capability.
High endurance, high efficiency, guaranteed operation time.
Error tolerance <1mm, meets the highest testing standards.
Improved laser port for measurement/attack/radiation, one tool with many functions.
Internal systems come with all the latest software for your convenience.

Egret-type support drone
Preinstalled modules: 4
Number of drones that can be controlled under normal operations: 2
Number of drones that can be controlled under [redacted] operations: 5
Backup drones: 3
Be sure to equip your drones as appropriate for the situation on the ground.
Module list:
R23 module: High efficiency refrigeration module. Default operations impede targets, capable of freezing on activation.
LRBD module: Laser mining module. Default operations fire an industrial laser at the target, capable of increasing power output for a short time upon activation.
#66 module: armed attack module, default operations make use of the survey apparatus's assault port. When enabled, attacks a target within range. Activation greatly upgrades the assault port.
[Redacted] module: effects unknown, please contact the module technician for more information.

Huh? What's this supposed to be? Am I not a Caster? What's going on?
--Caster Operator Z.R.'s note upon reading the report.
text.zh:
【源石技艺概览】
“麦哲伦定制探险套组，内含泛用型多功能测绘仪与龙腾式支援无人机，鲁特拉工作室、莱茵生命科研设备研发科联合出品！”

泛用型多功能测绘仪
高温、高寒、高压，全环境稳定工作。
超长续航、高效充能，保证运行时间。
误差范围＜1mm，符合顶级测绘要求。
改良激光口，测量/攻击/照射一端多用。
内置各式软件，合理使用，对身心有益。

龙腾式支援无人机
已装载模块数：4
普通模式可操控无人机上限：2
【保密】模式可操控无人机上限：5
备用无人机：3
请根据实际情况装配及使用无人机
以下为模块列表
R23模块：高效制冷模块。默认散布时迟滞目标，激活后可直接冻结。
LRBD模块：激光开采模块。默认启用时可对正下方发射工业级射线，激活后短时间增强功率。
66号模块：武装打击模块，默认与测绘仪的攻击端口共享目标，开启即可对范围内目标进行攻击，激活后所有攻击端口都将获得大幅提升。
【保密】模块：效果未知，请联系模块安装者以获取具体信息。

欸，我是看了什么？我不是术师干员吗？这是什么？
——术师干员Z.R在报告下的批注

text.en:
As a field specialist for Rhine Lab, Magallan has participated in numerous exploration projects over quite some time. her primary area of interest is sparsely populated ice sheets. Whether this is out of personal fascination or habit at this point, we cannot say. 
Normally, she sets out in early summer so as to return before the start of winter, gathering data herself from the unexplored land to the north of Rhine. During the last round of personnel transfers, Magallan received new orders and she began preparing to move her base of operations to Rhodes Island. 
Prior to arriving at Rhodes Island, Magallan's resupply was largely handled by experienced couriers, thanks mostly to security concerns. As such, she is familiar with a number of logistics firms. Interestingly, Magallan seems to have a good relationship with the boss of Penguin Logistics, 'Emperor,' such that some operators have expressed envy. 
Why exactly that is, no one can be certain.
text.zh:
作为莱茵生命的外勤专员，麦哲伦很早就参与进了各类勘查项目，而人烟稀少的冰原一直是麦哲伦的主要研究目标。这可能出于兴趣，也可能出于习性。
通常，她会在初夏时开始任务，初冬前返回，为莱茵积累来自北方未探之地的一手资料。在之前的人事调动中，麦哲伦接到了派驻干员任命书。近期，出于工作需要，麦哲伦准备将行动基地转移到罗德岛上。
加入罗德岛前，出于安全性和保密性考量，麦哲伦的补给工作主要交由有经验的信使完成，麦哲伦也和许多物流公司打过交道。令人在意的是，麦哲伦似乎与企鹅物流的老板“Emperor”非常要好，好到让某些员工都产生了嫉妒之情。
至于原因是什么，其实没人清楚。

text.en:
Magallan's cabin was built with a small secret compartment, which upon getting approval from the operator responsible for corridor engineering was allowed to be expanded, without changing the internal structure of the ship. We won't have any problems with illegal alterations like with Mayer's workshop. 
The compartment remains rather small, but is big enough for Magallan to conduct her research. One wall was turned into a large display screen, showing the results of her recent expeditions, including her notes and theories, as well as photos of important places taken in the field. Specimens and test results litter the room, and although she has done her best to keep it all organized, one can't help but feel a little overwhelmed by it all. 
Rhine Lab's research projects involve a lot of cutting-edge technology, and some projects are beyond the capacity of even Rhodes Island's researchers to analyze. If somebody cried out in the cafeteria, 'are those Rhine Lab people all geniuses?' It wouldn't even raise many eyebrows. But if you climbed up into Magallan's lab compartment, you'd realize it's not just raw talent that produces such results, it's also an entire cabin's worth of effort. 
And more.
text.zh:
麦哲伦的舱室建有一个隐蔽的小阁楼——这是向该走廊的工程负责人申请后允许扩建的，并没有改变舰船的固有结构，不存在类似梅尔工作间的违建问题。
阁楼的空间不大，但对研究而言绰绰有余。一面墙被改造成了大显示屏，麦哲伦历次探险的成果与发现的疑点列得满满当当，重要的地方还附上了实地拍摄的照片。标本和测量结果摆得到处都是，虽然已经被她整理得井井有条，却让人难免感觉到些许严丝合缝的窒息感。
莱茵生命的研究项目中包含了大量的尖端科技，部分研究成果甚至能让罗德岛的研究者们也无力解析。在这种情况下，即使在食堂里高喊“莱茵生命的人都是天才吗”也不会有太多干员侧目。不过，当你爬上麦哲伦的阁楼时，你会意识到，创造了成果的并不只是天赋，还有一整舱的努力。
甚至更多。

text.en:
From the Black Flow of Bolívar to the high plains of Kazimierz to the submerged volcano of Iberia... Terra holds countless gems worthy of exploration, but humanity's curiosity has long been obscured by the haze of conflict.
Magallan stands alone in the desolate deserts of ice. Away from relatives, friends, and the comfort of civilization, she seems to have little to keep her company except the ice and snow in her hands. Even though the results from her expeditions yield great research value, there are many who cannot understand the choices she makes. However, Magallan's motivations are simple - the goals she wants to pursue have always been crystal clear and unwavering—
The nursery rhymes that were whispered into her ears as a child told her about the icy lands of the far north that had been forgotten by humanity, finally reduced to legends and tall tales. The final verses sung of an ancient history lost and buried beneath the ice, never opening their arms even to those who would try to remember them.
These fantasies have long been Magallan's reality. Praised as a child, doubted as a young woman, criticized as an adult. While no one can understand her choices, the motivation for Magallan's constant exploration stems from her love for the pursuit of knowledge and the persistence to chase her dreams.
Rhine Labs opened their doors to her, and after submitting her application, she chose the codename that she still uses today: 'Magallan.'
text.zh:
现处玻利瓦尔境内的黑流树海，卡西米尔的环山高地平原，伊比利亚水下的火山……大地上有无数值得探索的地方，人们却被眼下的纷争遮盖了好奇心。
麦哲伦独自一人驻足于荒凉的冰漠。在那里，她远离亲友，身处恶劣的环境之中，似乎除了手握的冰雪之外一无所有。即使她频频带回极具研究价值的考察成果，却依旧有许多人无法理解她的选择。只是，在麦哲伦心中，她所追求的目标总是清晰而明朗，从来没有半分改变——
儿时的歌谣萦绕在耳旁，向曾为孩童的她诉说极北被人遗忘的过往，然而，覆灭为其终曲，歌谣最后的词句让一切都失落，将一切深深埋入冰层，古老的事实由此成为传说，也不曾为铭记其事迹者敞开怀抱。
梦幻般的歌谣成了小麦哲伦的梦想。小时候，那些人赞许她；少年时，那些人怀疑她；成年后，那些人批评她。她的选择没人能理解，但麦哲伦不断探险的动力，既来自她对一切知识的热爱，也来自于她对梦想的坚持。
莱茵生命向她打开大门，接过了申请书的她选择了一个使用至今的代号——“麦哲伦”。

text.en:
'Magallan? A researcher... I remember her. She's very open-minded, good to all of her colleagues. But you know, survey operators go out on extremely long missions. I imagine there's very few people who could put a face to her name. Maybe Ifrit and Muelsyse are the only exceptions.'
'They get along very well. After all, there aren't many people at Rhine Lab who can settle Ifrit down.'
'And Muelsyse, that Muelsyse... Can you imagine what Magallan and Ifrit call her? Hahaha... Ah, hah. They call her Mewmew.'
'Iffy and Mewmew.'
'Magallan the researcher... all I can say is she's really something special.'
'You could say she's really something different from us science punks.'
text.zh:
“麦哲伦？这个研究员……我记得。很开朗的人，对各位同事也都很好，但你也知道，勘察干员的任务周期相当长，能够一直记着她的人不太多。可能伊芙利特和缪尔赛思是个例外。”
“她们的关系真的很融洽，毕竟，整个莱茵生命里能够让伊芙利特安静下来的也没几个。”
“还有缪尔赛思，那个缪尔赛思……你能想象麦哲伦和伊芙利特是怎么称呼她的吗。哈哈哈哈……咳，哼。她们叫她缪缪欸。”
“伊芙芙、缪缪，噗。”
“麦哲伦研究员……只能说，她真的很神奇。”
“也许，她真的和我们这些科学混账不太一样。”
